baseline_numeric_drift.row_identity: Source hash, original pixels, phase, inclusion, series name, x source, export mode and calibration status.
baseline_numeric_drift.interpretation: Historical and current baseline used different CPU threading. Accuracy counts alone do not establish identical numbers.

license_and_models.import_authorization: Maintainer explicitly selected both named server models on 2026-09-21; REV-009.

runtime_resource_observations.protocol_runtime_clarification: Python conversion/parity uses synchronous 80-percent work/rest. Native validation uses the 80-percent aggregate job cap and full affinity; it does not implement cooperative per-core work/rest. The protocol flat cpu_work_rest_percent field must not be interpreted as an observed native per-core guarantee.
runtime_resource_observations.timing_limit: Wall time is measured under the job cap. Shared OCR provenance is pipeline timing, not separate detector/reader CPU time. Parity reports contain per-model random-tensor timings.

known_limitations: Every arm remains below at least one unchanged Tier 1 development bar. No sealed/private acceptance or production switch is authorized by these results.
CSV inputs comprise 20 train and three dev sources; partitions are reported separately. Training-source gains are not held-out acceptance.
Server detector execution exposes calibration argument failures. They remain full source failures; missing panel diagnostics are explicitly recorded.
Baseline numeric values differ by at most the recorded small amount under changed threading, despite identical accuracy counts.
Tokenizer support and split reporting are verified, but no full production-model set or new packaged build was produced.

decision.server_detector: Not selected: fewer exact labels and markers, fewer correct CSV values, higher runtime.
decision.server_recognizer: Retain as a development option for diagnosis; do not promote. Text gains coexist with four lost exact readings, unchanged CSV dev counts, and increased wrong-phase rows.
decision.server_both: Not selected: combined configuration loses text, markers and CSV values against the current baseline.
decision.next_work: Repair calibration confidence validation and continue the preregistered off-center marker experiment with its unchanged V44/mobile OCR baseline. Diagnose reader phase regressions before any downstream selection.
